expected_issues.title: Length tie-break uses the clamped length, so different names compare equal
expected_issues.description:
After the 'optimization', the length tie-break compares `len` (already clamped to the shorter of the two lengths) instead of compareTo.length(), so names that share a prefix but differ in length compare as equal and the mapper can select the wrong host/context/wrapper.

`len` is set to min(compareTo.length(), end - start) at the top of compare()/compareIgnoreCase(). Replacing compareTo.length() by len in the final tie-break means `len > (end - start)` can never be true and `len < (end - start)` only when compareTo is shorter. E.g. comparing '/ab' against '/abc' now returns 0, which breaks the binary search used to map request URIs to contexts. The original length must be kept in a separate variable.

expected_issues.title: Mapper comparison change has no test for names that differ only in length
expected_issues.description: compare()/compareIgnoreCase() drive the binary search that maps hosts, contexts and wrappers. The change alters the length tie-break and ships without a unit test; a test comparing a name with a longer or shorter name sharing the same prefix (e.g. '/ab' vs '/abc') would have caught the regression.
